name: fold-stale-edit-of-another-case-of-a-strict-file-is-denied-where-the-disk-folds-case
description: strict_mode lists plan.md. Session A reads plan.md, session B reads it, edits it and commits, so A's read is stale; A then pre-edits PLAN.MD. On a case-insensitive disk (caseless) PLAN.MD is plan.md: the strict glob matches it and A is denied exactly as strict_mode 05 denies an edit of plan.md, with the reason and summary.path echoing PLAN.MD as A sent it. Where the disk keeps case apart (nfd, none) PLAN.MD is another file that neither plan.md pattern matches, and A is admitted: no denial. The row checks only that; a tracked admission and an untracked one answer the same {ok: true}. The two summary timestamps are ignored; every other summary field is compared. Both backends.

hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecisionReason: Stale read denied: PLAN.MD was updated by agent 814dac78 at <TS>. Re-read PLAN.MD via the Read tool before proceeding. This denial is structural (v0.2 strict mode); retrying the same operation will produce the same denial.
